verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows only first-party assets: official SDKs, the CLI, the Agents SDK and the OpenAI Cookbook. It also has community discussion comparing Codex with Claude. There is no evidence of community curated lists, third-party tools, routers or actively maintained third-party integrations, and first-party resources and model tool-calling to third-party services do not show a living community ecosystem.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the community ecosystem around the model is genuinely alive — curated lists, third-party tools, routers, and integrations with active maintainers
